title: Asynchronous Pipeline (pipeAsync) with Error Recovery
concept: Point-Free Async Function Composition & Pipe Architecture
problemStatement: Implement `pipeAsync(...fns)` that chains functions from left to right, where each function can be synchronous or return a Promise. If any step throws or rejects, allow an optional recovery handler passed via `pipeAsync.recoverWith(handler)`.
interviewTrap: Using synchronous `Array.prototype.reduce` without awaiting promises inside the accumulator will return unresolved promise chains.

testCases.name: Pipes value through synchronous and async transforms in order
testCases.testFn: const add5 = x => x + 5; const doubleAsync = async x => x * 2; const sub2 = x => x - 2; const pipeline = pipeAsync(add5, doubleAsync, sub2); return pipeline(10);

testCases.name: Handles single function pipeline
testCases.testFn: const p = pipeAsync(async s => s.toUpperCase()); return p('hello');

detailedExplanation.conceptualOverview: Currying converts a function taking N arguments `f(a, b, c)` into a sequence of N unary functions `f(a)(b)(c)`. When total collected arguments `>= fn.length`, the underlying function executes.

2. Execute logic adhering to ECMAScript standard specification.
3. Verify invariant boundaries and edge conditions.
